text:
**Status: Supported.** The current assessment identifies approximately **81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2021**, or **2.23%** of the property. The finding is corroborated under the assessment method; an earlier pending assessment has been superseded.

Of the loss area, 68.1 hectares were mapped as planted pine forest, 13.2 hectares were outside mapped forest, and none was mapped as native forest. A further 37.3 hectares of loss occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares and was not counted as an event.

Tree-cover loss does not by itself establish deforestation or land-use change. The evidence also does not establish the cause, legality, responsible party or regulatory compliance.
